notes.title: GO HEROES Live on Kickstarter
notes.content:
We are two indie devs from Athens, and we are making Go Heros.
We are on Kickstarter, and we need your support to reach our goal to finish the development.
http://goheroes.games/ks

notes.title: GO HEROES IS LIVE ON KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36067795/0f35417ec9c483984292596bfe9b1d7a40d31832.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello, Heroes![/b][/h1]
[h3]GO HEROES is live on [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/happyland-games/go-heroes]Kickstarter[/url][/b]. We are almost in the middle of the campaign and have reached 38% of our goal. We've made this game with love and we believe in it with all our hearts!

if you too believe that GO HEROES is unique and deserves to become a complete game, please support the campaign. Share the campaign with friends who you think might be interested in playing GO HEROES: Prometheus demo. Your support can make our dreams come true.[/h3]

[h3]You can get the game at a discount price and your name in the credits as rewards for backing the project!

[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36067795/bd5a34f14618f4193107ebdfa7ff5e4e4b024440.png[/img]

[h3]PS: We've uploaded a new version, "0.5.3", of the game, with fixes and improvements for you to enjoy! 

*Please pay attention to the tutorials; I promise you it is worth it! 

Thank you.
GO HEROES Team[/h3]

notes.title: GO HEROES GAMEPLAY and SETTINGS discussion!
notes.content: Embark GO HEROES and dive into the everlasting Greek myths. Fight mythical creatures, collect loot, wield legendary weapons and explore a vast world in a cross-genre casual action-adventure mixed with turn-based combats on a grid terrain.

notes.title: DEMO 0.4.0 Updates and Upgrades
notes.content:
[b]DEMO 0.4.0[/b]
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for playing GO HEROES Demo and giving us very insightful feedback that leads to the first big update of the demo, and we hope you enjoy it!

[b]New mechanic: [/b]
- You now carry the pillar -enjoy

[b]Controls[/b]
- You can now use your mouse to control your camera and WASD to move!

[b]CHECKPOINT[/b]
- Auto-Checkpoint indication improvement.
- Better Tutorial explanation
- A cinematic camera directs you to your target in the new areas
- A flair indicates the target shrines to make the exploration more fun! (Now you know what you have to do)

[b]Minor Upgrades[/b]
- Use ESC to navigate freely in and out of the Game Menu. 
- More ropes and less backtracking in Hephaestia.

[b]NEXT STEPS for the DEMO[/b]
- 1 new Skill with a Mechanic that you'll get from the beginning of the game.
- A new type of in-game collectible.
- 2 New Mythological Bosses at the Cape of Cloe and Hephaestia.

Thank you so much for being here!

GO HEROES Team
(Vicky and Marinos)
